newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia expands English language teaching at schools.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia expands English language teaching at schools.

text.p: Tunisia on Tuesday said it was expanding English language teaching in school to open itself to the outside world and improve ties with English speaking countries.
Education Minister Hatem Ben Othmane told a press conference that the teaching of English would be extended by two years from this schoolyear.
"This is to reinforce ties of friendship and cooperation with the English speaking world and particularly with Great Britain," an education ministry statement said.
Tunisia's education system is based on Arabic and French, the language of the former colonial ruler.
Ben Othmane said the teaching of other foreign languages was also being reinforced.
In addition to Arabic, French and English, pupils will also be allowed to learn a fourth language from either Spanish, German and Italian starting in the second year in secondary schools.
Basic education is compulsory from the ages of six to 16.
